readme.markdown:
# ScanHood has moved

This repository's code has moved to **[github.com/scanhood/scanhood](https://github.com/scanhood/scanhood)**,
now hosted under ScanHood's own official GitHub account rather than a personal one.

**cassh100k** remains a core developer on the project. Everything here (the
safety API, honeypot scanner, and MCP server) is preserved as history; new
work happens at the new repo from now on.

- Live site: https://scanhood.xyz
- New repo: https://github.com/scanhood/scanhood
- Docs: https://scanhood.xyz/docs

toolsPreview.name: scan_token
toolsPreview.description: Composite on-chain safety verdict for any Robinhood-Chain (chain 4663) token: honeypot buy+sell simulation, LP-lock status, contract verification, deployer reputation, RWA-impostor detection. Returns PASS/CAUTION/DANGER.

toolsPreview.name: search_token
toolsPreview.description: Find any Robinhood-Chain token by symbol, name, or address across the whole chain (not just the top pairs).

toolsPreview.name: get_ohlcv
toolsPreview.description: On-chain OHLCV candles for a pool, for charting/backtesting.

toolsPreview.name: get_swap_quote
toolsPreview.description: Read-only swap quote (no execution) for a token against the ScanHood swap contract — expected output for a given ETH-in (buy) or token-in (sell).

toolsPreview.name: build_launch_tx
toolsPreview.description: Build (but do not sign or send) a launchToken transaction against ScanHood's live no-rug launchpad on Robinhood Chain — either Uniswap V3 (anti-snipe protection, supports an atomic initial buy) or V4 (Uniswap's newest, no anti-snipe window). Returns raw unsigned tx fields (to, data, value, gas) for the caller's own wallet to sign and broadcast — ScanHood never holds funds or keys. On success the token's liquidity is locked (V3: locker-held position; V4: locker-held one-sided position) and cannot be pulled.

toolsPreview.name: get_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Returns the token addresses a wallet has saved to its ScanHood watchlist.

toolsPreview.name: save_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Overwrites a wallet's saved token watchlist (up to 200 tokens). Requires a signature proving ownership of the address: sign the exact string in 'message' with that wallet's key (e.g. personal_sign / EIP-191) and pass it as 'signature'. Not usable without real wallet-signing capability.

toolsPreview.name: get_streak
toolsPreview.description: A wallet's consecutive-day ScanHood usage streak.

toolsPreview.name: get_scan_log
toolsPreview.description: Recent completed token safety scans across all of ScanHood (real activity, not a sample) — powers the "recent rugs caught" / "safe launches today" homepage modules. Optionally filter by verdict.

toolsPreview.name: get_scan_rollup
toolsPreview.description: Daily counts of PASS/CAUTION/DANGER verdicts plus a sample of real DANGER catches per day, for up to 60 days back. Powers the weekly "State of the Chain" report.

toolsPreview.name: get_token_extra
toolsPreview.description: Holder concentration (top10Pct), dev wallet %, and holder count for a token, sourced from the live trenches collector.

toolsPreview.name: apply_partner_key
toolsPreview.description: Get a free, higher-rate-limit (40r/s vs the 5r/s anonymous default) API key for a site that links back to scanhood.xyz. ScanHood fetches the site itself and checks for a real <a> to scanhood.xyz before issuing a key — self-reported claims are rejected. One key per site; re-applying with the same site returns the existing key.

toolsPreview.name: get_partner_status
toolsPreview.description: Look up which site a partner key is registered to, when it was issued, and whether it has been upgraded to the paid tier.

toolsPreview.name: get_paid_tier_info
toolsPreview.description: Treasury address and minimum payment to upgrade an existing partner key from the free tier (40r/s) to the paid tier (200r/s) via a Robinhood-Chain ETH payment.

toolsPreview.name: upgrade_to_paid_tier
toolsPreview.description: After sending at least the minimum ETH (see get_paid_tier_info) to the treasury address on Robinhood Chain, submit the transaction hash here to upgrade an existing partner key to the paid tier (200r/s). Verifies the payment on-chain before activating — each txid can only be used once.

toolsPreview.name: get_bots_stats
toolsPreview.description: Stats from ScanHood's own arbitrage and fee-claim bots.

toolsPreview.name: get_bots_claim_prefs
toolsPreview.description: Per-token preferences for automatic trading-fee claiming.

toolsPreview.name: set_bots_claim_prefs
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable automatic fee claiming for a token. Requires a signature proving ownership of 'address': sign the exact string in 'message' with that wallet's key and pass it as 'signature'. Not usable without real wallet-signing capability.
